reason: Re-opened packet.js tanakh 100 --verse 12:13 (Rashi has nothing on 12:13, so Radak is a fair lead). Radak at 12:13 (lemma לא תמות): לא תמות מות רשעים שתרד נפשך בגיהנם ... אבל תענש בעולם הזה: carries 'sparing him the death of the wicked in Gehinnom, though he is punished in this world'. Metzudat David at 12:13 (lemma גם ה׳): כי גמול הראוי הוא להיות נפש תחת נפש, אבל רק על מקצת העון שלם ישלם, וגם העביר מחטאתך וכפר מקצתה ... ולא תמות: carries 'sparing the life owed for Uriah's, part of the sin being atoned'. They genuinely differ (death of the soul in Gehinnom against the bodily life owed for a life) and are named without resolution. Plain sense matches 12:7 to 13 (Nathan's charge at 12:9 names the killing and the taking); no four-word run from the key. verse.js ok (2 Samuel 12:13, at [274,13]; the verse ends inside Nathan's speech, which continues at 12:14, but ends in a full stop as the rule allows); entry-check ok, no errors or warnings.
